subject: dec
title: DEC.------C.ACT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 349 (R(AS)CM(I)-33). DEC (decentralization) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names C-ACT (composite activism); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From DYM-F: EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis). From EXP-INFO-B: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From POST: POL-DY (political dynamics) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and SPI-GH. From SPI-GH: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications).
